oral_examination.oral_examination: *48 High vertical impaction, the mucosa covers the distal maxillary surface, and the gums are red, swollen, and congested. Nothing special. *47 Ink-like changes can be seen on the maxillary surface, and the texture is hard. source_handle: *48 Local disinfection with povidone-iodine, alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride, and infiltration anesthesia with bistriol around the wisdom teeth. After the anesthesia takes effect, a horizontal incision is made to separate the gums, loosen the teeth, and push out the teeth. Routinely scrape the tooth extraction wound, suture it, and apply pressure to stop bleeding. 7*47 Remove all decay, prepare the cavity, blow-dry the cavity, apply adhesive, fill with resin, light-cure, adjust the high points of the filling body, and polish.
